summary: Optional warn-first CI check flags UI-touching PRs that lack embedded user-attachments images, names bad URLs, and documents PLATE_UI_PR_IMAGE_ENFORCE for fail mode.
migration_impact: Adopters receive the optional ui-pr-image workflow and may customize UI globs in .agentic/ui-paths.yml; default mode warns only.
agent_notes: Only https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/... counts. Use Visual evidence: not applicable — <reason> to skip. Third-party cloud agents should route UI screenshot work to Copilot.
